links.outcome: Reliability of incremental model updates under label noise and distribution shift with a sanity-check filter
links.effect: Self-aware SGD, which filters unreliable gradient updates, is reported to give reliable incremental updates under distribution shift with label noise. No numbers are reported in the abstract.
links.quote: Experimental evaluations on the Oxford University Hospital datasets highlight that self-aware SGD can provide reliable incremental updates for overcoming distribution shifts in challenging conditions induced by label noise.

unlisted_practices: Contextual-bandit sanity check that filters unreliable gradient updates during incremental learning of deployed clinical models

screen.reason: Evaluates a deployment-oriented safeguard mechanism (Self-Aware SGD with sanity checks via contextual bandits) designed to ensure safe and reliable continual/incremental adaptation of deployed clinical AI models under distribution shifts and corrupted data.

primary.practice: safeguarded incremental model updating under distribution shift and label noise
